contracts.contract: trait annotation defines a safety proposition
contracts.intended: isSafe expresses the extra safety invariant of an unsafe trait
contracts.implemented: generate_trait emits Trait.Safe Self inst : Prop with user-authored isSafe fields

contracts.intended: unsafe impl Trait for T must prove Trait.Safe for its implementation
contracts.implemented: ImplAnnealBlock has only common context, rejects isSafe, and ParsedItem::Impl is ignored by generation

contracts.contract: generic trait bound exposes the invariant
contracts.intended: T: Trait makes safety evidence available to the generated consumer spec
contracts.implemented: trait bounds generate only explicit trait dictionaries such as TraitInst : Trait T

contracts.contract: consumer can request the invariant explicitly
contracts.intended: proof can rely on isSafe when justified
contracts.implemented: checked-in anatomy example adds requires (h_is_safe): Unaligned.Safe T Inst and applies it to UnalignedInst

semantic_consequence: V1 models isSafe as an opt-in logical proposition, not as a globally enforced consequence of Rust unsafe-trait implementation and trait-bound semantics.
